scenarios.title: singular access
scenarios.description: Bind one book, return its title — the degenerate FLWOR on-ramp and the pattern of a $data-style lookup.

scenarios.title: filter + project (spec A.2)
scenarios.description: Select the books under $10, order them by price, and project title/price objects.

sources.fontoxpath:
for $b in $doc?store?book?*
  where $b?price lt 10
  order by $b?price
  return map { "title": $b?title, "price": $b?price }

scenarios.title: join (spec A.3)
scenarios.description: Correlate books with a ratings array on isbn. Jaren recognizes the uncorrelated equijoin and answers it from a hash table, so it is O(n+m) where the competitors run a naive O(n·m) nested loop — read the ratio here as a different algorithm, not a faster engine. Capped at 1,000 books, because raising it would grow their cost quadratically and Jaren's linearly.

sources.fontoxpath:
for $b in $doc?store?book?*, $r in $doc?ratings?*
  where $b?isbn = $r?isbn
  order by $b?price
  return map { "title": $b?title, "stars": $r?stars }

scenarios.title: group + aggregate (spec A.4)
scenarios.description: Group books by category and compute count and average price per genre. fontoxpath does not implement the XQuery group by clause.

scenarios.title: deep reshape
scenarios.description: Rebuild the store as a catalog: computed labels, nested pricing objects, and a bicycle summary in one constructor document.
